cohort.primary_population: Equal-weight mean of five stratum means. Each stratum contributes 0.2 regardless of its acquired question count. The target preserves the original balanced task mixture with unequal sampling precision.

registration.classification: Prospective confirmation of a frozen transferred one-decision policy on new questions; local timestamped protocol.
registration.motivation: The completed retrospective target-backend analysis shows a positive utility contrast against always SEARCH and a matched-rate random mixture. The original source-condition advancement gate remains failed. This confirmation targets the distinct backend-transfer policy with a target-experience cost threshold.
registration.hypothesis: A fixed text gain predictor trained on source executions, combined with a target-development cost estimate, improves API-token utility over both constant actions on new target-backend questions.

questions.identity: Every candidate question is absent from prior native node files. All candidate support pages are disjoint from the original 120 model-training questions.
questions.selection_pages: Within each stratum, ranks prioritize pages absent from the prior 400-question method-selection cohort, then include remaining training-disjoint candidates. Report actual overlap and the fully selection-page-disjoint sensitivity. This distinction is fixed before qualification.
questions.selection: Take the first 200 eligible questions per stratum by frozen rank. Qualify initial batches of 400 per stratum, with 600 for four-hop questions; use the ordered reserve if needed. Resolve qualification before any new actor outcome. A deficit after exhausting the pool stops actor acquisition.
questions.reference_eligibility: Require a reference-hidden Flash solution with valid evidence quotes, supported reference checks from Flash and Pro, and a context-isolated AI canonical-reference audit classified supported. The hidden answer must match the canonical answer or pass masked semantic equivalence. Retain all rejections. Independent audits assess aliases before accepted answer variants are frozen.

primary_policy.decision: SEARCH iff the frozen gain exceeds 0.005 times the fixed target-development mean extra tokens divided by 1000. Ties choose THINK.

execution.tool_contract: Reuse the target budget-study request schema, one tool call per reply, shared total completion envelope, and cached exact retrieval queries.
execution.failures: Keep algorithmic terminal failures at zero. Preserve transport attempts and repair pending work before complete-frame analysis.

registration.frozen_predictions: After reference eligibility, freeze all four neural/guarded predictions and both source/target cost rules before any actor request. Obtain Flash raw probability forecasts before actor outcomes and apply the existing source120 and target40 numerical fits without new reward fitting.
registration.primary_endpoint: Flash frozen-reference equivalence, with masked Pro, paired-judge and normalized-EM secondary endpoints. Blank, UNKNOWN and failed delivery retain zero reward.
registration.primary_success_rule: At lambda 0.005, both utility contrasts against always THINK and always SEARCH must have one-sided 97.5% lower bounds above zero. Also require the one-sided 97.5% lower bound for success minus always SEARCH above -0.01. Report all criteria independently.
registration.secondary: Matched-rate random mixture, probability/gain risks, source-cost threshold, probability heads, guarded heads, raw forecasts and fixed numerical maps. All five existing token valuations, every stratum, the selection-page-disjoint subset, independent endpoints and reference bounds remain reported.
registration.inference: Question-weighted means and 10000 support-component bootstrap draws. Recompute the matched random fraction within each bootstrap sample. Report actual support-component counts. Draws do not increase independent question N. Use the exact frozen endpoint and policy definitions throughout.

power.classification: Planning from the retrospective matched-backend pilot; no fresh outcomes.

registration.cost_scope: Token utility prices actor and any API forecast tokens. The primary text head makes zero inference API calls; measure CPU prediction time separately. Qualification and research counterfactual collection are acquisition expenses.

resources.accounting: Use a separate campaign ledger and cache so the existing Qwen campaign retains its owner and caps. Credentials are read from the existing project configuration and are not copied into this run. Aggregate usage by ledger namespace.

registration.scope: One native bounded continuation decision on new reference-supported English multi-hop questions. This study supplies no repeated-decision deployment claim.

sampling_amendment.classification: Prospective sampling amendment before any new actor outcome or policy forecast on the candidate pool.
sampling_amendment.reason: All 865 four-hop candidates completed provider reference qualification; 145 passed, so the original 200-per-stratum quota is impossible under the fixed reference criteria. Independent reference review remains mandatory.

sample.musique_4: All independently source-supported cases from the complete original four-hop pool.

sampling_amendment.selection: For the four fixed-size strata, take the first 400 jointly eligible questions by original frozen rank. Audit the complete four-hop provider shortlist and retain every independently eligible case. Keep all original questions, page-disjoint rules, models, thresholds, endpoints, and success criteria. Complete qualification and freeze the selected cohort before forecasts and actors.
sampling_amendment.primary_target: Equal-weight mean of five stratum means. Each stratum contributes 0.2 regardless of its acquired question count. The target preserves the original balanced task mixture with unequal sampling precision.
sampling_amendment.inference: Sample the original support components with replacement, preserving components that cross strata. Within every bootstrap replicate, recompute each stratum mean with its sampled question multiplicities, then average the five means equally. Report 10000 draws and the actual component structure. The random-mixture comparator matches the weighted search rate in every replicate.
sampling_amendment.secondary: Report question-weighted pooled scores, all five stratum scores, selection-page-disjoint views, all registered endpoints, policies, token valuations, and source-reference bounds. These views preserve their explicit target populations.

power.assumptions: Planning uses sixteen retrospective pilot questions per stratum. The calculations assume independent questions and may understate component dependence or variance after reference qualification. Final precision is measured on the complete frozen cohort.

resources.reason: The amended cohort requires 8 executions per selected question and at most 3 searches per SEARCH draw. Acquisition, forecasts, judgments, retries and independent reference qualification share the study ledger.

sampling_amendment.reference_quality: All existing qualification and independent source-support criteria remain in force. Aliases require equivalent verdicts; failures and rejected references stay retained.

analysis_protocol.primary: Flash reference-equivalence endpoint, equal five-stratum weights, frozen finetuned_gain head, fixed target40 extra actor-token mean, lambda 0.005.
analysis_protocol.inference: 10000 component bootstrap draws with seed 2026101815. Draw components globally, preserving cross-stratum memberships; normalize weights within each stratum to 0.2. Redraw empty-stratum bootstrap replicates and report their count.
analysis_protocol.criteria: Both utility lower bounds above zero, plus success-minus-always-SEARCH lower bound above -0.01; all use one-sided 97.5% bounds.
analysis_protocol.secondaries: Question-weighted pool, each stratum, selection-page-disjoint views, four endpoints, all source-trained and previously fitted numerical maps, source and target cost rules, five existing token valuations, matched-rate random control, and shared-judge bounds.
analysis_protocol.cost: Primary CPU head has zero inference API tokens; time CPU inference separately. Raw and corrected API forecasts charge reported forecast tokens per question, constants charge zero inference tokens. Acquisition is separate.
analysis_protocol.scope: Prospective one-decision saved-branch comparison on newly acquired questions and actor draws.

inference_addendum.timing: Cohort metadata examined after actor acquisition started and before reading any outcome or judgment. The audit records 86 existing actor result files at that time.
inference_addendum.change: Preserve point estimates and shared-label identification ranges for every registered view. Withhold bootstrap confidence bounds and pass/fail inference when a fixed-weight stratum has fewer than two observed support components. Apply the same rule to single-stratum views.
inference_addendum.affected_registered_view: selection_page_disjoint_equal_strata: four-hop question count 1, component count 1.

public_input: Predict from the input object. Identifiers join records. Strata, support components, outcomes, references, resource records and selection-page flags are evaluator metadata.
weighting: The primary comparison weights five strata equally; question-weighted scores are secondary. Preserve shared support components and answer-case identities.
cost: Supplied inference_API_tokens are charged in standalone policy scoring. CPU inference time and acquisition expenses remain separate.
measurement: Four reference-equivalence/EM endpoints; shared unresolved answers retained. All reference reviews and judgments are AI assessments; zero human labels.
scope: One prospective frozen policy comparison on new questions. Further methods fitted to these outcomes require an independent test frame.
